provenance.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: responsive website social group hero placeholder photography
Primary request: create a candid, energetic photo of a diverse Malaysian friend group enjoying a social sim-racing session together in an anonymous contemporary gaming venue, matching the approved comp's cinematic black-and-red visual world without copying its layout or branding
Input images: Image 1 is a style, lighting, mood, and crop reference only; do not reproduce its logos, text, interface, or exact people
Scene/backdrop: dark indoor sim-racing venue with abstract red linear ceiling lights and indistinct racing stations in the background
Subject: five young adult friends gathered naturally around one seated driver, genuine shared excitement; respectful, natural representation; hands and steering interaction anatomically plausible
Style/medium: photorealistic candid editorial event photography, real skin texture, subtle grain, not glossy stock photography
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape, group clustered through the middle and right, clear facial expressions, slightly wider safety margins for responsive center cropping; no text-safe area is required because headline will overlay outside or via gradient in code
Lighting/mood: controlled low-key exposure, red practical lights with restrained warm highlights, deep near-black shadows, welcoming and social rather than aggressive
Color palette: near-black, racing red, warm natural skin tones, tiny neutral highlights
Constraints: anonymous fictional venue and fictional people; no text; no logos; no trademarks; no readable game UI; no equipment model specificity; no watermark; do not imply documentary evidence of Xerom
Avoid: esports tournament staging, trophies, uniforms, brand marks, purple-blue cyberpunk palette, fake signage, distorted hands, duplicate people, baked-in gradients or UI
